misconception_description: Student believes that a variable assigned an arithmetic expression containing other variables automatically updates its value when those variables change.

solutions.generated_code:
program HitungPasanganTidakSama
kamus
  a, b, c, jumlah, hasil : integer
algoritma
  input(a, b, c)
  jumlah <- 0
  hasil <- jumlah
  if a != b then
    jumlah <- jumlah + 1
  endif
  if a != c then
    jumlah <- jumlah + 1
  endif
  if b != c then
    jumlah <- jumlah + 1
  endif
  output(hasil)
endprogram

metadata.modification_notes: The student assigns `result = cnt` at the beginning when cnt is 0, genuinely believing that result will automatically update whenever cnt changes throughout the loops. They think they're creating a dynamic link between result and cnt rather than copying a value. From their perspective, this is a cleaner approach - set up result to "track" cnt at the start, then return result at the end. They don't realize that result is frozen at 0 and will always return 0 regardless of how many times cnt is incremented. The student believes their code is correct and equivalent to the original.
